basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas, who recently got interested in personal finance and investing. Outside of work, I enjoy playing 'For Honor' and collecting vintage Atari 2600 games. I tend to browse Reddit during evenings and weekends. I'm single and currently focused on building my career and financial portfolio. I dislike negativity and people who don't respect community guidelines.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge in investing is mostly self-taught through online courses and reading books. I have a tech background, which helps me understand some of the tech-focused investments that ARK offers.
